title: Homelab Savings
tagline: What does your homelab save you?
payback.none: Enter what your hardware cost to see when it pays for itself.
payback.never: With these numbers the running costs are at least as high as the savings, so the hardware does not pay for itself.
payback.pending.one: The hardware pays for itself after about {n} month.
payback.pending.other: The hardware pays for itself after about {n} months.
payback.pendingDate.one: The hardware pays for itself after about {n} month, around {date}.
payback.pendingDate.other: The hardware pays for itself after about {n} months, around {date}.
payback.reached.one: The hardware paid for itself around {date}, after about {n} month.
payback.reached.other: The hardware paid for itself around {date}, after about {n} months.
services.title: Services you self-host
services.hint: For each one, enter what its cloud equivalent would cost you. A new one counts from the month you add it: open its details (▾) to change that, to set when you stopped using it, or to add a description.
services.empty: Nothing here yet. Pick a service from the list or add your own.
power.title: Electricity
power.note: About {kwh} kWh per month, {cost} per month.
hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.hint: Each purchase counts in full in its month for the total saved so far, and is spread over the months above for the monthly figure.
others.title: Other costs
others.hint: Domain, VPN, a faster internet plan, backups...
field.name: Name
prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.currencyNote: Changing the currency does not convert your amounts.
footer.privacy: Your numbers stay on your own server.
footer.saveFailed: Could not save. Your changes may be lost.
total.label: Saved so far
total.unknown: Enter the month you started (Costs, Hardware) to see how much you have saved so far.
total.future: The start month is still ahead, so nothing is saved yet.
chart.title: Over time
chart.hint: Money kept since the start, after paying for the hardware. Each service and cost counts only for the months it was in use.
chart.label: Money kept over time. It starts at minus the hardware cost and reaches zero at the break-even.
backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Save your numbers to a file, or load them back from one.
backup.confirm: Replace the numbers on this page with the ones in the file?
backup.invalid: This file is not a Homelab Savings backup.
tabs.label: Sections
field.untilHint: The last month it counts. Set this instead of removing it, to keep it in the total saved so far.
action.removeConfirm: Remove it? It also disappears from the total saved so far. To keep it there, set an end month instead.
hardware.empty: No purchases yet. Add what you bought: the server, disks, a UPS...
purchase.name: What you bought
price.title: Price over time
price.hint: If the price changed, add the month and the new price. The price in the row is always today's.
power.changesHint: If your price per kWh changed, add the month and the new price. The field above is always today's price.
ranking.title: What saved the most
ranking.hint: What each service has saved so far.
ranking.hintMonth: What each service saves per month now. Enter the month you started to see what each one has saved so far.
